name: Fuses
summary: Fuses that blow to protect wiring: glass, ceramic, blade, cartridge and resettable types.
uses: Replacing blown fuses in appliances and vehicles
identify: Glass and ceramic tubes (5 × 20 mm, 6 × 30 mm) in appliances and power supplies; coloured plastic blades in every vehicle fuse box; big ANL and Mega fuses in RV, boat and inverter wiring. The amp rating is printed or colour-coded.
test: Near 0 Ω across the fuse is good; open means blown. Always replace with the same amp rating or lower.
